roleContext.roleTitle: New Product Introduction Project Manager, Office Seating
roleContext.jobDescription: A manufacturer of office chairs designs in its UK studio and builds in plants in Poland and Mexico. The New Product Introduction (NPI) Project Manager takes each new chair from design freeze to volume production: running the stage-gate plan, coordinating tooling suppliers, organising pilot builds at the plants and closing out build issues before launch. The role involves travel to the plants for about one week in four. The studio releases two or three new chairs a year, and each programme runs for about 14 months from design freeze. The NPI Project Manager reports to the head of operations and works with the industrial designers, the purchasing team and the quality engineers. Pilot builds take place at whichever plant will make the chair in volume, and launch dates are agreed with the sales team a year ahead.

# Curriculum vitae

Target role: New Product Introduction Project Manager, Office Seating

## Experience

- Ran the stage-gate plan for three new desk ranges at Holloway Contract Furniture, from design freeze to volume production, holding each gate with engineering, purchasing and quality.
- Tracked 11 tooling suppliers against the tooling schedule, chasing first-off samples and logging each tool's approval date.
- Organised two pilot builds per range at the company's Midlands plant, logging build issues and closing them with the plant engineers before the volume gate.
- Prepared the gate-review packs (cost, schedule, open issues, test results) for the product steering group.
- Personal details: age 41; divorced; sole carer for an elderly parent; Irish citizen.

## Work samples

- Work sample: a gate-review pack for one desk range at the pilot-build gate, with the cost roll-up, the schedule against plan, 14 open build issues with owners and the BIFMA test results.
